data.desc: Alpha Technology Group Limited is the first Hong Kong-based artificial intelligence company to go public on NASDAQ. We specialize in creating customized artificial intelligence models (Exclusive-LLM or SLM) and their applications essentially, tailored artificial intelligence brains to help businesses and governments reduce costs, increase efficiency, optimize strategic decision-making, and enhance operational effectiveness. With ESG-compliant, scalable AI-driven solutions, we lead digital transformation for businesses of all sizes. Our AI platform serves as the intelligent hub, where customized models unlock data value, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and manage risks. Combined with consulting and planning services, we optimize the entire business process to support the implementation and smooth evolution of ESG goals.
